title: Can I BEAT Dice Chess?
summary: Dice Chess on a separate dice-chess website (not chess.com) vs online humans: each turn you roll three dice whose faces show piece types, and you must make one move with each rolled piece type (so up to three moves per turn). King can be left in check - you win by capturing the king. Goal: win three games; he complains about wasted triple-rook rolls, notes a double knight roll is overpowered, and wins three, declining a final rematch.
rules: On your turn press ROLL: three dice, each face showing a piece type (pawn, knight, bishop, rook, queen, king).
Make one move for each die with a piece of that type, in any order; a die whose piece type has no legal move is skipped (inferred).
Moves within a turn are sequential, so the same piece can move multiple times if its type is rolled multiple times (e.g. three rook dice and only one rook: it moves three times).
No checkmate: the king may be left or walk 'through check'; the game is won by capturing the king (5:00 'you have to capture the king').
Win popup shows a coin/money reward (site feature).
win_condition: Capture the enemy king. Series goal: 3 wins.
